passages.provision_quote: The right to marry is a fundamental right.
passages.note: ACA 5's operative text guarantees marriage as a fundamental right with no discrimination-protection or religious-exemption clause, but the vote on it was near-unanimous.
Wiener is listed among the Ayes on the Senate Floor passage of ACA 5, but the vote was 31 Ayes to 0 Noes, i.e. near-unanimous, which cannot establish the chair alone.

rows.reasoning: Wiener voted Aye on ACA 5 (2023-2024), a constitutional amendment establishing that 'the right to marry is a fundamental right,' which would fit the rung guaranteeing same-sex marriage the same benefits and protections as any other marriage. However, the Senate Floor vote passed 31-0 with zero Noes, making it near-unanimous under V4.1, so it cannot support a chair alone, and no own-words statement from Wiener on this topic is available to corroborate.
needs_source: An own-words statement (speech, interview, op-ed, or questionnaire answer) by Wiener on same-sex marriage recognition, to corroborate or replace the near-unanimous ACA 5 vote
